faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes! The free plan gives you 10 messages per day to explore the service. No credit card required.
faq.q2: What's the difference between Free and Premium plans?
faq.a2: Free users get 10 messages/day with basic AI and no chat history. Premium users get 30 premium messages/day with advanced AI (GLM-4), permanent chat history, and conversation management. After exceeding 30 premium messages, Premium users can continue with the basic model.
faq.q3: What is the Fair Use Policy?
faq.a3: To ensure fair access for all users, Premium plans include 30 premium messages per day using our advanced AI model. After reaching this quota, you can continue using the service with the basic AI model at no extra cost. The premium quota resets daily at midnight UTC.
faq.q4: What's the difference between the AI models?
faq.a4:
GLM-4 (Advanced): More nuanced understanding, deeper insights, better at complex philosophical concepts. Used for first 30 messages/day for Premium users.
glm-4-flash (Basic): Faster responses, good for casual conversations and basic guidance. Used for free users and after premium quota.
faq.a5: Refunds are calculated based on your actual message usage (user messages only, not assistant responses). Within 48 hours with ≤5 messages, you get a full refund. After that, we calculate a prorated refund based on messages used vs. your plan's daily allowance.
faq.q6: What happens to my chat history if I cancel?
faq.a6: When you cancel, your subscription ends immediately. Your chat history remains accessible in your current billing period. After the period ends, your account reverts to Free tier and chat history features are no longer available. We recommend exporting important conversations before cancellation.
faq.q7: Can I change between monthly and annual plans?
faq.a7: Yes! You can upgrade from monthly to annual at any time through your dashboard. When changing plans, your usage counter resets, giving you a fresh 30-message premium quota.
faq.q8: Is this a medical or mental health service?
faq.a8: No. Ask Zen Insight is an entertainment and personal spiritual exploration tool. The AI guidance provided is for informational and reflective purposes only. It is NOT professional medical, mental health, legal, or financial advice. If you're experiencing a mental health crisis, please contact emergency services or qualified healthcare professionals immediately.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.q1: Do I need to create an account?
gettingStarted.a1: Yes, all plans require a free account registration. Creating an account is free and only takes a minute. It allows you to track your usage, manage your subscription, and upgrade to Pro plans for additional features like chat history and advanced AI.
gettingStarted.q2: How do I start a conversation?
gettingStarted.a2: Simply navigate to the Chat page and start typing. Your first message can be anything - a question, a concern, or just a thought. koji will respond with Zen-inspired guidance.
gettingStarted.a3: You can discuss anything related to your spiritual journey, life decisions, emotional challenges, or philosophical questions. Common topics include: meditation practice, relationships, work stress, personal growth, and finding meaning in life.

plansPricing.title: Plans & Pricing
plansPricing.q1: What's the difference between Free and Pro plans?
plansPricing.a1: Free users get 10 messages/day with basic AI (glm-4-flash) and no chat history. Pro users ($2.99/month or $24.99/year) get 30 premium messages/day with advanced AI (GLM-4), permanent chat history, multiple conversation management, and unlimited basic model usage after quota.
plansPricing.q2: What is the Fair Use Policy?
plansPricing.a2: To ensure fair access, Pro plans include 30 premium messages per day using advanced AI (GLM-4). After reaching this quota, you can continue using the basic AI model (glm-4-flash) at no extra cost. The premium quota resets daily at midnight UTC.
plansPricing.q3: What's the difference between the AI models?
plansPricing.a3:
GLM-4 (Advanced): Deeper insights, better understanding of complex philosophical concepts, more nuanced guidance. Used for first 30 messages/day for Pro users.
glm-4-flash (Basic): Faster responses, suitable for casual conversations. Used for free users and after premium quota.
plansPricing.q4: Can I change between monthly and annual plans?
plansPricing.a4: Yes! You can upgrade from monthly to annual at any time through your dashboard. When changing plans, your usage counter resets, giving you a fresh 30-message premium quota.

subscriptionBilling.title: Subscription & Billing
subscriptionBilling.a1: Click the "Subscribe" button on the Pricing page or in your dashboard. You'll be redirected to our secure payment processor (Creem) to complete your subscription.
subscriptionBilling.q2: How do I cancel my subscription?
subscriptionBilling.a2: You can cancel directly from your dashboard. Click the "Cancel Subscription" button and follow the prompts. Cancellations take effect immediately, and you'll retain access until the end of your current billing period.
subscriptionBilling.a3:
We offer refunds within 7 days of subscription:
• 48 hours: Full refund if you've used 5 or fewer messages
• After 48 hours: Prorated refund based on actual usage
• Up to 7 days: Cancellation requests accepted (subject to review)

Read the full Refund Policy for details.
subscriptionBilling.a4: Refunds are based on your actual message usage (user messages only). Within 48 hours with ≤5 messages = full refund. After that, we calculate: (Plan Days - Days Used) / Plan Days × Refund Percentage × Plan Price.
subscriptionBilling.q5: What happens to my chat history if I cancel?
subscriptionBilling.a5: When you cancel, your subscription ends immediately. Your chat history remains accessible until the end of your current billing period. After that, your account reverts to Free tier and chat history features are no longer available. Export important conversations before cancellation.
subscriptionBilling.q6: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
subscriptionBilling.a6: Yes. If you're not satisfied within 48 hours and have used 5 or fewer messages, you're eligible for a full refund. Contact support@zeninsight.xyz to request a refund.

usingService.title: Using the Service
usingService.q1: How many messages can I send per day?
usingService.a1: Free (registered) users: 10 messages/day with basic AI. Pro and Annual subscribers: 30 premium messages/day with advanced AI (GLM-4), plus unlimited basic model usage after quota. The quota resets at midnight UTC. Note: All plans require a free account registration.
usingService.q2: What happens when I reach my daily limit?
usingService.a2: Free users will see an upgrade prompt. Pro users will be switched to the basic AI model (glm-4-flash) but can continue using the service without interruption.
usingService.a3: Yes. Your conversations are confidential. For Pro subscribers, chat history is stored securely in your account. We do not share your conversations with third parties. See our Privacy Policy for details.
usingService.q4: Can I delete my chat history?
usingService.a4: Yes, Pro users can delete individual conversations from the sidebar. Click the trash icon on any conversation to permanently delete it and all its messages.
usingService.a5: Yes! Pro and Annual subscribers can create and manage multiple conversations. Each conversation is saved separately, making it easy to organize different topics or life areas.

aboutService.title: About the Service
aboutService.a1: koji (meaning "Emptiness and Stillness") is your AI Zen meditation teacher. Designed to emulate Buddha's wisdom, koji provides compassionate guidance using Zen philosophy, natural metaphors, and heuristic dialogue.
aboutService.a2: No. While koji draws from Buddhist and Zen philosophy, the service is non-religious and focuses on philosophy, psychology, and personal growth rather than religious rituals or promoting superstition.
aboutService.q3: Is this a medical or mental health service?
aboutService.a3: NO. This is an entertainment and personal spiritual exploration tool. It is NOT professional medical, mental health, or psychological advice. If you're experiencing a mental health crisis or thoughts of self-harm, please contact emergency services or qualified healthcare professionals immediately.
aboutService.q4: Can koji help with serious mental health issues?
aboutService.a4: No. koji is not qualified to provide mental health diagnosis or treatment. For serious mental health concerns, depression, anxiety, or crisis, please seek professional help from licensed therapists, counselors, or healthcare providers.
aboutService.q5: What AI models do you use?
aboutService.a5: We use Zhipu AI's GLM models. Pro users get GLM-4 (advanced) for the first 30 messages/day. All users have access to glm-4-flash (basic). We are not affiliated with Zhipu AI.

privacySecurity.title: Privacy & Security
privacySecurity.a1: Yes. We use industry-standard encryption and security practices. Your data is stored securely in Supabase databases. We never sell your personal information or conversations to third parties.
privacySecurity.q2: Do you train AI models on my conversations?
privacySecurity.a2: No. We do not use your conversations to train AI models. Your chats remain private and are only used to provide the service to you.
privacySecurity.a3: We collect account information (email, name), usage data (message counts for billing), and chat history (for Pro subscribers only). See our Privacy Policy for full details.
privacySecurity.a4: Currently, we don't offer a data export feature. However, you can manually copy important conversations. We're working on adding a data export feature in the future.
privacySecurity.q5: How do I delete my account?
privacySecurity.a5: To delete your account, please contact support@zeninsight.xyz. Account deletion is permanent and will remove all your data, including chat history and subscription information.

techSupport.title: Technical Support
techSupport.q1: The service isn't working. What should I do?
techSupport.a1: First, try refreshing the page. If that doesn't work, clear your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists, contact support@zeninsight.xyz with details about the problem.
techSupport.q2: I'm seeing an error message. What does it mean?
techSupport.a2:
Common errors include:
• "Daily limit exceeded" - You've used your message quota. Wait until midnight UTC or upgrade.
• "API error" - Temporary connection issue. Try again in a moment.
• "Unauthorized" - You may need to sign in again.

If you see other errors, please contact support.
techSupport.a3: We support all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. For the best experience, use the latest version of your browser.
techSupport.a4: Currently, Ask Zen Insight is a web-based service that works on any device with a browser. We're exploring mobile app development for the future.

billingPayments.title: Billing & Payments
billingPayments.a1: Payments are securely processed by Creem, our merchant of record. Creem handles PCI DSS compliance, and we never see or store your credit card information.
billingPayments.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
billingPayments.a2: Creem accepts major credit cards and debit cards. The available payment methods depend on your location.
billingPayments.a3: Applicable taxes may be charged depending on your location. The final price will be shown before you complete your purchase.
billingPayments.q4: Can I update my payment information?
billingPayments.a4: Yes. You can manage your payment method through the billing portal accessible from your dashboard.
billingPayments.q5: Do I need to manually renew my subscription?
billingPayments.a5: Yes, subscriptions are one-time purchases that must be manually renewed. We'll send you a reminder email before your subscription expires. You can purchase a new subscription anytime from the Pricing page or your dashboard.

about.zenHistoryTitle: Zen Buddhism in China: 1500+ Years of Wisdom
about.zenHistoryP1: Zen Buddhism (known as Chan in Chinese) has a rich history spanning over 1,500 years in China. Originating in the 6th century with the legendary figure Bodhidharma, Chan Buddhism represents a unique synthesis of Indian Buddhist philosophy and Chinese wisdom traditions like Taoism.
about.zenHistoryP2: The Essence of Zen Wisdom: At its core, Zen is about directly perceiving the true nature of reality - the suchness (tathāta) of life and the world. It teaches that awakening is not found in distant realms or abstract concepts, but right here in our everyday experience.
about.zenHistoryP3: Daily Practice as Transformation: Through seated meditation (zazen), mindfulness in action, and contemplative inquiry, Zen practitioners cultivate the ability to face life's challenges with equanimity and clarity:
about.zenWorkCareer: Work & Career: Bringing mindful presence to daily tasks, transforming ordinary activities into spiritual practice
about.zenRelationships: Relationships: Responding to others with compassion, wisdom, and non-attachment
about.zenAdversity: Adversity: Meeting difficulties with acceptance, resilience, and insight into impermanence
about.zenSelfUnderstanding: Self-Understanding: Seeing through the illusion of separate self-existence to realize interconnectedness
about.zenElevating: Elevating Life's Realm: The goal is not escape from the world, but engagement with it - living with greater freedom, authenticity, and wisdom. As the saying goes: "Chop wood, carry water" - before enlightenment, and after.
about.zenContinues: {siteName} continues this tradition by making Zen wisdom accessible through modern AI technology, supporting your journey toward greater understanding and peace.
about.heuristicDialogueDesc: Rather than giving direct answers, koji guides you through questions to observe your own heart. Like a mirror, it reflects your thoughts without judgment, helping you find answers within yourself.
about.naturalMetaphorsDesc: Uses imagery from nature - water, clouds, mirrors, the moon - to explain abstract truths about impermanence, attachment, and the present moment.
about.nonJudgmentalPresenceDesc: Fully accepts your negative emotions without blame. Like a clear spring reflecting your state of mind, koji acknowledges your feelings before offering guidance.
about.allPlansRequire: All plans require a free account. Sign up to get started.
about.notMedical: {siteName} is NOT a medical or mental health service.
about.aiGuidanceFor: The AI guidance provided by koji is for entertainment and personal spiritual exploration only. It is not:
about.notDiagnosis: Diagnosis or treatment of any condition
about.crisisWarning: If you are experiencing a mental health crisis, having thoughts of self-harm, or need immediate assistance, please contact emergency services or qualified healthcare professionals right away.

about.howItWorksP2: Our service combines modern AI technology with ancient Zen philosophy to create a unique space for reflection and spiritual growth. The AI has been carefully designed to emulate the wisdom and compassion of a Zen meditation teacher.
